rca of the issue: RCA: `createMapMarkerIcon` builds marker class using `driver-${status}` and `status='offline'`, producing `.delivery-map-marker-driver-offline`. In App.css, gradient style exists for `.delivery-map-marker-driver-idle` instead of `.delivery-map-marker-driver-offline`. Repro: login admin -> tab Hartă -> observe offline count badge >0 -> inspect first `.delivery-map-marker-driver-offline` computed backgroundImage is `none`. Mitigation: standardize to one token (`offline`) across marker HTML and CSS (including legend class names if needed).
